description: Scripts the gatekeeper helper's answer from a tag in the prompt it is given. Question cards: [GATE-DECIDE] takes the default, [GATE-ASK] escalates with a brief, [GATE-BAD] answers prose (every time, so the retry fails too), [GATE-HANG] never answers. Stop decisions (the prompt carries a <last> block): [STOP-NUDGE] continues with a default, [STOP-BLOCKER] calls it a blocker, [STOP-DONE] calls it finished, [STOP-BAD] answers prose (every time). Anything else escalates with nothing else said.
